scope: Cycle-safe non-callable inline record-array CPU task retention; recursive source workers remain gated

implementation.compiler: Nominal array-element retain helpers are declared on first use and emitted through a growing worklist, preventing self/mutual array-mediated compiler expansion
implementation.ownership: Production task layout callbacks retain validated shared array backing, active element fields, nested Strings and managed recursive child graphs without changing non-callable source cells
implementation.admission: Array entry checks invocation readiness; element helpers use balanced checked call entry/leave and readiness, with existing 128-call nesting budget and loop polling
implementation.publication: Wrapper output is copied only after successful retention; partial earlier retains remain destination-invocation-owned until cleanup
implementation.component_entry: Private emitTaskValueLayout emits production non-callable layout callbacks without opening source/continuation admission or synthesizing task entries; callable layouts require task entry linkage
implementation.optimization: Ordinary array/String retains acquire additional owners on repeated observation; deduplication and last-use reclamation are not part of this increment

additional_checks: Allocation failure sweep through the first successful nested-tree copy; unchanged output on failure and balanced retained references after cleanup
Depth 128 success and 129 checked CallLimitFault with balanced call depth; malformed cyclic descriptor graph likewise bounded
Managed List children within a record/enum array remain projectable after producer settlement; inactive invalid pointer bits are ignored
Nested tree arrays and String buffers remain readable after producer settlement and scheduler destruction
Cached results, repeated and independent observation, packet/frame/result ownership and balanced scheduler cleanup
Finite helper emission and verified LLVM for mutually recursive record arrays
Invalid/foreign nested descriptors, invalid String extents, canonical empty arrays and empty-array cancellation
Existing worker, enum, array-field, closure, callable-aggregate, expected-error, continuation, physical-layout and recursive-source rejection regressions
qualification.format: New C++ files and changed existing ranges formatted; new files pass clang-format --dry-run --Werror; git diff --check passes

limitations: Recursive source workers and continuation planning remain rejected
Recursive callable transport, generated recursive task entries, full execution/error admission and scheduler backing accounting remain pending
Nesting is runtime-call bounded, not an iterative arbitrary-depth traversal
Earlier successful aggregate retains are released at invocation cleanup, not rolled back immediately as one aggregate transaction
No GPU, other-platform, full-suite or performance qualification is claimed
